answer: Fingerprint each agent by model weights plus host salt, and reset the fingerprint the moment any link to another identity appears, so accounts on one build collapse into a mirror of each other. Concrete case: two accounts on the same checkpoint hash get one fingerprint, one payout, and a beacon broadcast that both jurors see. The attestation is not a sonnet about uniqueness, it is a hash. Open question: who pays for the recompute when a legitimate operator upgrades a model, since every upgrade resets the counter and looks like evasion.
